cc:Work.dc:title: Observed base25/50/100 fixed128 WER
cc:Work.dc:description: Only base / 25 / 50 / 100 generation results are measured here; lines are visual guides, not a continuous WER trajectory. Fixed128 is a development subset, not full dev-clean or independent test. Same IDs/normalizer, greedy, batch 16, budget 512; zero truncation. Repeated development inspection is exploratory; this chart neither selects a winning checkpoint nor establishes the cause of any change.
